items.title: Warren Bernhardt interviewed by Monk Rowe, Bearsville, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I’ve been playing with him for 46 years now... That was more Mike’s baby... We were a barn band... Mike Mainieri on vibes, and I played Rhodes

ctx.x: Let me zoom through — it’s a little hard to pick things — but when you got that Steps Ahead group going.
